hypothesis: Original private C# source gets rewritten before runtime helper copying, method extraction and harness project generation. A late exception in those steps therefore leaves a project with modified originals and no valid offline harness; previous source-write rollback does not cover this case.
proposed_fix: Move install_adapted_originals to the last mutation in prepare() once all harness files are generated; preserve existing source preflight and failed-write exact byte rollback.
test_strategy: New synthetic failure-in-harness-generation regression with original bytes intact, no published original data; existing 10 A10 tests and SHA-authenticated private managed offline CI.
overlap_check: A1/FFT, A2/DISPLAY, A3/A5/HAPTICS/DELIVERY, A6/A9/RENDER, A8/DIAG, A7/INPUT; A10-only source file and own tests.
constraints: No Unity, APK, OBB, XAPK, Release or automation
No original game private source or assets uploaded
No changes to .rgd schema, .meta or GUIDs
limitations: Does not guarantee atomic rollback of generated harness files
Does not prove Unity or on-device original world lifecycle
